question: What division of the eight octads is sought to be known fully?
premises: A division consisting of eight octads is mentioned.
The speaker seeks to know this division fully.
The knowledge is sought in an exhaustive manner.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and exhaustively the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: The precise content of the eight octads is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I wish to know fully and without end the division of the eight octads.
